```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
```

```{r}
df <- read_csv("hotel_bookings.csv")
df
```
------ EDA ---------
```{r}
# 1. Basic structure
glimpse(df)
summary(df$adr)
summary(df$stays_in_weekend_nights + df$stays_in_week_nights)

# 2. Cancellation rate — know what you're dropping
df %>% count(is_canceled) %>% mutate(pct = n/sum(n)*100)

# 3. ADR sanity check — there are known zero/outlier ADR rows
df %>% filter(adr <= 0 | adr > 5000) %>% nrow()

# 4. Date range
df %>% summarise(min(arrival_date_year), max(arrival_date_year))

# 5. Market segments present
df %>% count(market_segment, sort = TRUE)

# 6. Missing values in columns you'll use
df %>% select(adr, market_segment, hotel, is_canceled,
              stays_in_weekend_nights, stays_in_week_nights,
              arrival_date_year, arrival_date_month,
              arrival_date_day_of_month) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~sum(is.na(.))))

```
----Clean Data------
```{r}
#keep only non-cancelled bookings 
df_clean <- df %>% 
    filter(is_canceled == 0) %>%
  mutate(
    # Build a proper arrival date
    arrival_date = as.Date(paste(
      arrival_date_year,
      arrival_date_month,
      arrival_date_day_of_month
    ), format = "%Y %B %d"),
    
    # Total revenue proxy (ADR × nights stayed)
    total_nights = stays_in_weekend_nights + stays_in_week_nights,
    total_revenue = adr * total_nights,
    
    # Rooms available proxy — not in dataset, use constant per hotel type
    # City Hotel capacity ~300, Resort Hotel ~226 (from the paper)
    rooms_available = if_else(hotel == "City Hotel", 300, 226),
    
    # Segment simplification
    segment = market_segment
  ) %>%
  filter(total_nights > 0, adr > 0)

df_clean
```

----- Calculate KPI -----
```{r}
# Daily aggregation
daily <- df_clean %>%
  group_by(hotel, arrival_date) %>%
  summarise(
    rooms_sold = n(),                        # bookings as proxy for rooms sold
    total_revenue = sum(total_revenue),
    adr = mean(adr),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    rooms_available = if_else(hotel == "City Hotel", 300, 226),
    occupancy_rate = rooms_sold / rooms_available,
    revpar = occupancy_rate * adr
  )
daily

# Monthly summary (cleaner for charts)
monthly <- daily %>%
  mutate(month = floor_date(arrival_date, "month")) %>%
  group_by(hotel, month) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_occupancy = mean(occupancy_rate),
    avg_adr = mean(adr),
    avg_revpar = mean(revpar),
    total_revenue = sum(total_revenue),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
monthly

# Segment summary
segment <- df_clean %>%
  group_by(hotel, segment) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_adr = mean(adr),
    bookings = n(),
    total_revenue = sum(total_revenue),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(hotel) %>%
  mutate(revenue_share = total_revenue / sum(total_revenue) * 100)
segment
```
```{r}
# 1. RevPAR range
monthly %>% summarise(min_revpar = min(avg_revpar), max_revpar = max(avg_revpar))

# 2. ADR by segment (City Hotel top 3)
segment %>% filter(hotel == "City Hotel") %>% arrange(desc(avg_adr)) %>% head(3)

# 3. Overall average occupancy
daily %>% filter(hotel == "City Hotel") %>% summarise(mean(occupancy_rate))

# 4. Average ADR overall
df_clean %>% filter(hotel == "City Hotel") %>% summarise(mean(adr))
```
----- RevPAR trend over time -----
```{r}
ggplot(monthly, aes(x = month, y = avg_revpar, colour = hotel)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::dollar_format(prefix = "€")) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#1a3a5c", "#c8a951")) +
  labs(
    title = "RevPAR Trend by Hotel Type",
    subtitle = "Monthly average, non-cancelled bookings only",
    x = NULL, y = "RevPAR (€)", colour = "Hotel Type",
    caption = "Source: Hotel Booking Demand dataset (Antonio et al., 2019)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```

----- ADR by market segment ----
```{r}
segment %>%
  filter(hotel == "City Hotel") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(segment, avg_adr), y = avg_adr, fill = revenue_share)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(revenue_share, 1), "% rev share")),
            hjust = 1.1, size = 3.5) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#c8e6ff", high = "#1a3a5c") +
  labs(
    title = "ADR and Revenue Share by Market Segment",
    subtitle = "City Hotel — non-cancelled bookings",
    x = NULL, y = "Average Daily Rate (€)", fill = "Revenue Share (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```
----- Occupancy vs ADR yield curve ------
```{r}
daily %>%
  filter(hotel == "City Hotel", occupancy_rate <= 1) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = occupancy_rate, y = adr)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, colour = "#1a3a5c", size = 1.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", colour = "#c8a951", linewidth = 1.2) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Yield Curve: Occupancy Rate vs ADR",
    subtitle = "City Hotel — each point is one day",
    x = "Occupancy Rate", y = "ADR (€)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```
